# Escuminac, New Brunswick

Escuminac is a small community located in northeastern New Brunswick, Canada, in Gloucester County. Here's what I can tell you about it:

## Location & Geography
- Situated on the Acadian Peninsula
- Located near the Baie des Chaleurs (Bay of Chaleur)
- Part of the Acadian region of New Brunswick

## Historical Significance
Escuminac is most notable for the **Escuminac Disaster of 1847**, a tragic maritime event:
- A severe storm struck the area on June 18, 1847
- Numerous fishing boats were caught in the bay and capsized
- Estimates suggest around 40-50 people lost their lives
- It remains one of the deadliest maritime disasters in Maritime Canadian history
- The event is commemorated locally and is part of regional history

## Character
- Primarily a rural, small community
- Has historical ties to Acadian culture and fishing heritage
- The area maintains its maritime character

## Present Day
- Remains a small settlement
- Population is modest
- Primarily residential/rural in nature
